skill_name: Describe how artificial intelligence is transforming the education sector.
workflow: Artificial intelligence is transforming the education sector by enabling personalization, automation, and streamlining processes. AI-enabled technologies, such as virtual assistants and chatbots, can provide 24/7 support to students and teachers alike. AI can also be used to create more personal learning experiences by tailoring content to each student's needs.
